terra.problem: The text does not say the soldiers kept their armor on.
The text says Jonathan had not heard the oath. It does not say he was the only man in the forest who had not heard it.
The text does not say Jonathan was the only person in the forest who ate, or what he knew about anyone else's eating.
The text does not say the troops stayed together or that they stayed close to where food might be.
“I'll let the text speak and not add more” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The construction remark is a flat observation rather than a joke or a helpful explanation.
The text does not say nobody saved anything for later.
“I won't guess why” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The text does not establish that nobody knew who was at fault or that Saul did not know Jonathan had tasted honey.
Ishvi is mentioned in this passage as one of Saul's sons, so saying he isn't mentioned in the story is misleading.
The text says Jonathan did not die, but it does not say he stayed or that nobody was banished.
